sections.A: GTPS hip ke bahar ki taraf greater trochanter par dard hai, aksar gluteal tendons ki tendinopathy ki wajah se. Tendon par dabao (compression) is ko barhata hai.
sections.B: Hip ke bahar dard jo ran ke bahar tak ja sakta hai, usi taraf letne, ek taang par khade hone aur seerhiyan charhne se barhta hai.
sections.C: Dard bilkul kahan hai aur kya usi taraf let sakte hain.
sections.D: Chaal, pelvis ka girna, greater trochanter dabana aur single-leg stance.
sections.E: Yeh clinical diagnosis hai. MRI mein tendon ki tabdeeli bina dard wale logon mein bhi hoti hai. Single-leg stance 30 second ka test ahem hai.
sections.F: Hip OA (groin dard aur internal rotation kam), FAI aur kamar se aata dard isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Runner ya kamzor haddi wale shakhs mein impact se dard (bone stress injury), ya girne ke baad fracture ka shak: refer.
sections.H: Red flags na hon, hip ke bahar dard, trochanter par dard aur single-leg stance par dard: gluteal tendinopathy.
sections.I: Gluteals aur TFL par soft tissue kaam se thori der ka aaraam.
sections.J: Sab se ahem: tendon ka dabao kam karna (taang cross na karna, side par letne ka tareeqa) aur abductor muscles ki dheere dheere barhti exercise.
sections.K: Barf, garmi aur TENS optional. Kai hafton ki exercise ke baad bhi dard rahe to shockwave.
sections.L: Hip, kamar aur SIJ screen karein, GTPS ko load aur dabao ka masla samjhayein, phir 8 se 12 hafte ki exercise.
sections.M: Dard, single-leg stance mein dard tak waqt, side par letne ka dard, VISA-G aur abductor taaqat dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 54 saal ki khatoon ko 6 mahine se usi taraf letne par hip dard se neend khulti hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: tendon ka dabao kam karna, load control aur dheere dheere barhti exercise.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
